description.value: The Tofino branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the community since 1968, when books arrived in wooden crates shipped by boat; it has occupied its current Main Street location since 2005. With a collection of nearly 9,500 items and two public computers, it is a genuine community hub in one of BC's most celebrated surf and outdoor destinations. Touring cyclists stopping in Tofino will find free WiFi and a welcoming public space in the heart of the village.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the branch's address (331 Main St, Tofino BC V0R 2Z0), phone (250-725-3713), and free public WiFi. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan/fee=no is corroborated by the website's 'Free public WiFi' feature listing. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears in either the OSM tags or the website content, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate public waypoint with confirmed free WiFi, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or follow-up with staff is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Book returns are open 24/7 per the website, which may be useful context for cyclists arriving outside staffed hours. The library manager is listed as Michael de Leur.

blurb: Main Street public library, serving Tofino since 1968.
